snippet.title: CURE - A Hospital Simulator - Creator Trailer
snippet.description:
🚨 Early Access is coming! 🚨
Get ready to build, heal, and survive in CURE – A Hospital Simulator, a game designed with creators in mind.

👥 Join the community: https://discord.gg/aR9CjkHFw2
🛒 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2786550/CURE__A_Hospital_Simulator/

💉 Creator-First Features
We’re building tools to make streaming, recording, and community interaction seamless.
🎥 Integrate your Twitch account directly into the game
💬 Enable real-time audience interactions and alerts
🧟 Let your viewers influence gameplay, even becoming patients (or zombies 😬)
⚙️ Customize engagement settings to fit any size community

👩‍⚕️ Play, perform, and entertain, your way.
Whether you’re a content creator, streamer, or just love chaos, CURE gives you control over both your hospital and your audience.

🏥 Launches in Early Access soon!
Join our growing community to shape the game’s future and get your setup ready for launch.

#CUREGame #HospitalSimulator #EarlyAccess #IndieGame #TwitchStreamer #ContentCreator #StreamerTools #Gaming
